summary: The supplied desktop and mobile captures show minor layout and readability issues. No major or critical defects are visible.

findings.description: [defect] On mobile, the Risk Exposure and Checklist Readiness cards share a row, but their progress bars and supporting copy start at different heights. Align those elements so the paired cards are easier to scan.

[defect] In the mobile filter grid, Changes Requested wraps and centers across two lines while the other labels sit on one line. Its wider dot-to-label gap also breaks the alignment established by Needs Review and Approved.
[defect] The mobile search field cuts the placeholder short after “domain” without an ellipsis, leaving the search hint looking unfinished.

[suggestion] In the full desktop capture, the specifications list extends roughly 250 pixels below the selected detail panel, leaving a wide empty area alongside the final rows. A denser list would bring the column endings closer together.
